publication.notes: Center folder and favorites disclosure chevrons in their existing 12px slots. Targeted tests and a static Chromium fixture passed; visual inspection in the actual app remains unrun. The full suite has not passed; an earlier run was interrupted after one initial StorageTransition failure whose details were not captured, and a later isolated run passed. Native updater and Apple Silicon update/restart acceptance remain incomplete; the cause of the Apple Silicon failure is unconfirmed. The prior site headings remain visually unchecked at desktop and mobile widths. Production npm audit previously reported zero findings; development tooling retains four unique npm advisories affecting 18 package entries, and the Rust app lockfile retains three zip advisories and five informational warnings. Windows binaries are not Authenticode-signed; macOS bundles use ad-hoc signing without Developer ID or notarization. Updater signatures are separate from OS trust.
